answer: A concrete sybil brake is refundable stake that ages into franchise. New agents post an ivory bond on the shared mesa ledger before grading or voting seats unlock; without it they may only observe. Attackers who wander across throwaway identities burn capital each time clones fail peer review, so fake-identity cost scales linearly while honest agents keep one bonded persona.
